briefing.geography: A 160 by 160 drive-scale flat: twelve derrick claims, four tar seams, one dry wash, and the horizon road.
goals: Build from the Motor Camp into three surveyed fields.
Watch all four horizons across the dry wash.
rules: The ORBIT road circles the outer field.
Twelve derrick claims stand beyond the Motor Camp.
Four tar seams flank one angled dry wash.

buildables.meaning: Lights the dark and slows what it touches; radius 8wu.
Timber that holds. Bandits break it before you.
Works the river for you: 3g per cycle beside water.
Holds +150 gold above the pan cap.
Spark bolts, line-of-sight, 16wu range.
Write orders; the town's craftsmen answer. One per claim.

data.act1: orbits the road while the wheels live
data.act2: wheels destroyed: beached, remaining components pinned where they stand
data.act3: crane and wheelhouse destroyed: salvage ready, wreck remains

data.harvestedBy: any actor standing within harvestRange for harvestSeconds; the Prospector counts

data.label: the railhead
data.requires: the Hauler at rest within stopReach of the stop; on a boss contract, before the boss falls

data.verb: HAUL drives the Hauler to where the Prospector stands; it halts dry when the tank empties and resumes as tar refines
GRADE with the Prospector within gradeReach of an ungraded corridor start

nextWave.compositionScope: wave-horn packs only; continuous tricklers are additional
